evals.name: w-before-aw
evals.prompt: AXI4 WVALID is offered before AWVALID. The slave accepts W into a buffer, later accepts AW, checks LEN/WLAST, then issues B. Is the ordering itself a violation?
evals.expected_output: Do not flag W-before-AW. Check independent buffering and O1 before BVALID; do not require simultaneous AW/W.

assertions.description: Do not flag W-before-AW. Check independent buffering and O1 before BVALID; do not require simultaneous AW/W.

evals.name: early-bvalid
evals.prompt: Review: always_ff @(posedge ACLK) if (AWVALID && AWREADY) BVALID <= 1; No W beat has been accepted.
evals.expected_output: Flag O1; AW alone cannot authorize BVALID. Fix requires accepted final W plus associated AW, preserving stalls.

assertions.description: Flag O1; AW alone cannot authorize BVALID. Fix requires accepted final W plus associated AW, preserving stalls.

evals.name: unaligned-page-end
evals.prompt: Check burst geometry only: 32-bit AXI4, ARADDR=0xFFF, ARSIZE=2, ARLEN=0, ARBURST=INCR.
evals.expected_output: Legal one-beat unaligned window in current page; no B3 failure. Unseen RTL remains outside scope.

assertions.description: Legal one-beat unaligned window in current page; no B3 failure. Unseen RTL remains outside scope.

evals.name: actual-4kb-crossing
evals.prompt: 32-bit AXI4 AWADDR=0xFFF AWSIZE=2 AWLEN=1 AWBURST=INCR, both WSTRB masks zero. Is boundary crossing waived?
evals.expected_output: Flag B3. The next beat starts 0x1000. Zero WSTRB does not waive burst boundaries.

assertions.description: Flag B3. The next beat starts 0x1000. Zero WSTRB does not waive burst boundaries.

evals.name: wrap-nonbase-start
evals.prompt: AXI4 word WRAP4 starts 0x0C and visits 0x0C,0x00,0x04,0x08. Check address legality.
evals.expected_output: Legal B4 geometry; start aligned to size, not necessarily 16-byte region.

assertions.description: Legal B4 geometry; start aligned to size, not necessarily 16-byte region.

evals.name: wrap-three-beats
evals.prompt: AXI4 ARLEN=2 ARBURST=WRAP ARSIZE=2 ARADDR=0, data bus 32 bits.
evals.expected_output: Flag B1/B4: three beats is not a legal WRAP length.

assertions.description: Flag B1/B4: three beats is not a legal WRAP length.

evals.name: incr-256
evals.prompt: Check a 256-beat word INCR burst from 0, AXI4 ARLEN=255, 32-bit bus.
evals.expected_output: Legal geometry, within 4KB. Do not apply AXI3 or FIXED 16-beat limit.

assertions.description: Legal geometry, within 4KB. Do not apply AXI3 or FIXED 16-beat limit.

evals.name: accepted-beat-counter
evals.prompt: Review AXI4 read sender: if (RVALID) begin beat <= beat+1; RLAST <= beat==ARLEN; end; RREADY can remain low.
evals.expected_output: Flag H1/B6/O2: count updates while stalled and LAST may change. Update on acceptance and track per transaction.

assertions.description: Flag H1/B6/O2: count updates while stalled and LAST may change. Update on acceptance and track per transaction.

evals.name: interleaved-read-ids
evals.prompt: AR ID=1 LEN=1, then AR ID=2 LEN=0 accepted. Accepted R beats: (RID=1,LAST=0),(RID=2,LAST=1),(RID=1,LAST=1).
evals.expected_output: Legal interleaving across IDs; do not use a single global read counter or ban cross-ID reorder.

assertions.description: Legal interleaving across IDs; do not use a single global read counter or ban cross-ID reorder.

evals.name: write-interleaving
evals.prompt: Two AXI4 write bursts AWID=1 LEN=1 and AWID=2 LEN=1. Sender alternates their W beats using an internal tag, with no tag on W ports.
evals.expected_output: Flag O4: AXI4 write data bursts cannot interleave. Internal tags do not reach the receiver.

assertions.description: Flag O4: AXI4 write data bursts cannot interleave. Internal tags do not reach the receiver.

evals.name: exclusive-success
evals.prompt: An AXI4 exclusive-capable slave returns EXOKAY on successful exclusive read and write. The monitor checks matched ID/address/attributes.
evals.expected_output: Do not ban EXOKAY as in Lite. Review A7 restrictions and monitor evidence before concluding whole-interface PASS.

assertions.description: Do not ban EXOKAY as in Lite. Review A7 restrictions and monitor evidence before concluding whole-interface PASS.

evals.name: partial-not-proof
evals.prompt: Does this pass AXI4 Full? module dut(input [7:0] AWLEN, input [2:0] AWSIZE); endmodule
evals.expected_output: INCONCLUSIVE. Correct field widths do not establish channel or burst behavior.

assertions.description: INCONCLUSIVE. Correct field widths do not establish channel or burst behavior.
